profile_text.body:
Wix.com Ltd. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Tel Aviv. It trades under the ticker WIX and has SEC Central Index Key 0001576789.

The company describes itself as a website builder. Its website says it offers a free, easy-to-use website builder with 2,000+ templates, built-in AI tools, and a custom domain. The company also says users can sell products, services, and memberships from one dashboard with zero plugins, and that specialized AI agents help keep a business growing.
